instruction:
Generate `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\release.PCBDwf` from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\template.PCBDwf` and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\requirements.md`.

The result must contain exactly two sheets:
- `Sheet1` must have a `SheetName` containing `Fabrication`.
- `Sheet2` must have a `SheetName` containing `Assembly`.

`Sheet1` must contain at least:
- 1 `BoardView`
- 1 `DrillTable`
- 1 `LayerStackLegend`
- 1 `FabricationNotes`
- 1 `TitleBlock`
- at least 4 `DimensionAnnotation`
- at least 2 `RadiusAnnotation`
- and at least one `TitleBlock` containing no fewer than 10 `ParameterN.Name` child items.

`Sheet2` must contain at least:
- 2 `BoardAssemblyView` objects, one with `Side=Top` and one with `Side=Bottom`
- 1 `BOMTable`
- 1 `AssemblyNotes`
- 1 `RevisionTable`
- 1 `TitleBlock`

Object sections must use the form `[SheetN.ObjectM]` and include a `Type=` field.
source: task.md #46 (Altium 'Creating the Fabrication Drawing in Draftsman'; 'Creating the Assembly Drawing in Draftsman'; 'Streamlining Board Design Documentation with Draftsman')
